bugs.desc:

bugs.short: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] Reel_Creator: Photo picker Import: imported photos unticked; tapping one adds it twice
bugs.creator: WILLY_WU
bugs.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Swipe the Launcher shortcut grid left to page 2
3. Tap Cinematic Reel Creator
4. Tap the single-color-fastcut card in the second section
5. Tap Use Template
6. Tap the album name at the top
7. Tap a test album
8. Tap 6 photos in the grid, one after another
9. Tap Next
10. Tap ‹ on the confirm page
11. Tap ‹ on the Preview
12. Press Home
13. Delete the first 2 picked photos in Gallery
14. Open PhotoDirector from Recents

17. Tap Import on the prompt
18. Tap the unticked imported photo in the grid
19. Check the result

4 photos are imported but only 3 are ticked in the grid; tapping the unticked one adds it again (5 in the tray).

{20.19.0_cr12_import_unticked.jpg} {20.19.0_cr12_duplicate_added.jpg}

Every imported photo is ticked in the grid with its number; tapping it unpicks it.
摘要：匯入的照片都應打勾編號，點擊應取消選取。

Note:

bugs.short: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] Reel_Creator: Wi-Fi lost during upload: 70 charged, 「Credits refunded」 but no refund
bugs.creator: WILLY_WU
bugs.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Swipe the Launcher shortcut grid left to page 2
3. Tap Cinematic Reel Creator
4. Tap the single-color-fastcut card in the second section
5. Tap Use Template
6. Tap 6 photos in the grid, one after another
7. Tap Next
8. Tap Generate
9. Turn Wi-Fi off when the upload starts (about 2 s later)
10. Tap OK on the error dialog
11. Turn Wi-Fi on
12. Tap the room's history icon
13. Tap Retry on the ⚠ card
14. Wait 9 minutes
15. Tap Create More
16. Tap the credit pill in the room
17. Tap Detail
18. Check the result

Result:
The dialog says 「Credits refunded」 but 70 stays charged (315 → 245, no refund); after Retry the card stays Almost Done.
摘要：提示已退點但實際扣 70 點未退；Retry 後卡片一直停在 Almost Done。
{20.19.0_cr25_credits_refunded_dialog.jpg} {20.19.0_cr25_retry_card.jpg} {20.19.0_cr25_after_retry_9min.jpg} {20.19.0_cr25_detail_no_refund.jpg} {20.19.0_cr25_log.txt}

Expect Result:
「Resume to Upload」 finishes the job with one charge; a failed job refunds the 70 credits.
摘要：應可續傳完成且只扣一次；失敗時應確實退點。

Note:
Device: Samsung Galaxy S23 (SM-S9110) / Android 16, Test Server
Spec Link: Reel Creator Design Figma (page 261109_AI_transition_feature, section Design), 05_Result_My_AI_Artwork frame -
